speaker_title: Address by Mr. Mario Draghi, President of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Italy

paragraphs.text: Mr. President of the General Assembly,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President of the General Assembly,

paragraphs.text: Mr. Secretary-General,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. Secretary-General,

paragraphs.text: Distinguished Delegates,
paragraphs.raw_text: Distinguished Delegates,

paragraphs.text: Ladies and gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Ladies and gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: In recent years we have witnessed a progressive weakening of multilateralism, which has guaranteed peace, security and prosperity since the post-war period.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In recent years we have witnessed a progressive weakening of multilateralism, 
which has guaranteed peace, security and prosperity since the post-war period.

paragraphs.text: However, we are now facing problems that we cannot solve on our own.
paragraphs.raw_text: However, we are now facing problems that we cannot solve on our own.

paragraphs.text: I am referring to the pandemic, and to the risk of new and dangerous variants of the virus.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I am referring to the pandemic, and to the risk of new and dangerous variants 
of the virus.

paragraphs.text: Climate change and the protection of biodiversity.
paragraphs.raw_text: Climate change and the protection of biodiversity.

paragraphs.text: The economic recovery and the fight against inequalities and food insecurity.
paragraphs.raw_text: The economic recovery and the fight against inequalities and food insecurity.

paragraphs.text: Conflict resolution and the fight against terrorism.
paragraphs.raw_text: Conflict resolution and the fight against terrorism.

paragraphs.text: These issues are at the heart of today’s General Assembly and of our Government’s agenda.
paragraphs.raw_text:
These issues are at the heart of today’s General Assembly and of our 
Government’s agenda.

paragraphs.text: They are also at the core of the Italian Presidency of the G20, whose motto is “People, Planet and Prosperity”.
paragraphs.raw_text:
They are also at the core of the Italian Presidency of the G20, whose motto is 
“People, Planet and Prosperity”.

paragraphs.text: We need to relaunch multilateralism, and make it effective to meet the challenges of our times.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to relaunch multilateralism, and make it effective to meet the 
challenges of our times.

paragraphs.text: More than a year and a half after the beginning of the global health crisis, we can finally look at the future with greater optimism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
More than a year and a half after the beginning of the global health crisis, we 
can finally look at the future with greater optimism.

paragraphs.text: The vaccination campaign gives us confidence in our ability to return to a new normal.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The vaccination campaign gives us confidence in our ability to return to a 
new normal.

paragraphs.text: In Italy and in Europe we have reopened most economic activities.
paragraphs.raw_text: In Italy and in Europe we have reopened most economic activities.

paragraphs.text: Students have returned to schools and universities.
paragraphs.raw_text: Students have returned to schools and universities.

paragraphs.text: After months of loneliness, our social life has finally resumed.
paragraphs.raw_text: After months of loneliness, our social life has finally resumed.

paragraphs.text: However, the pandemic is not over and even when it will be, we will have to deal with its consequences for a long time.
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, the pandemic is not over and even when it will be, we will have to 
deal with its consequences for a long time.

paragraphs.text: Globally, we face dramatic differences in the distribution of vaccines.
paragraphs.raw_text: Globally, we face dramatic differences in the distribution of vaccines.

paragraphs.text: In high-income countries, more than 65 per cent of the population has received at least one dose.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In high-income countries, more than 65 per cent of the population has received 
at least one dose.

paragraphs.text: In the poorest ones, only 2 per cent.
paragraphs.raw_text: In the poorest ones, only 2 per cent.

paragraphs.text: These disparities are morally unacceptable: fewer vaccinations mean more deaths.
paragraphs.raw_text:
These disparities are morally unacceptable: fewer vaccinations mean 
more deaths.

paragraphs.text: And as long as the virus continues to circulate freely, it can mutate in dangerous ways and put even the most effective vaccination campaigns at risk.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And as long as the virus continues to circulate freely, it can mutate in dangerous 
ways and put even the most effective vaccination campaigns at risk.

paragraphs.text: We need to increase the availability of vaccines for poor countries and overcome logistical hurdles to distribute them where they are most needed.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to increase the availability of vaccines for poor countries and 
overcome logistical hurdles to distribute them where they are most needed.

paragraphs.text: Furthermore, we must preserve at the global level the free circulation of vaccines and of the raw materials needed to produce them.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Furthermore, we must preserve at the global level the free circulation of 
vaccines and of the raw materials needed to produce them.

paragraphs.text: Italy gives its full political and financial support to the COVAX Facility.
paragraphs.raw_text: Italy gives its full political and financial support to the COVAX Facility.

paragraphs.text: We intend to triple our donations from 15 to 45 million doses by the end of 2021.
paragraphs.raw_text: We intend to triple our donations from 15 to 45 million doses by the end of 2021.

paragraphs.text: The huge differences in vaccination campaigns risk worsening inequalities between countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The huge differences in vaccination campaigns risk worsening inequalities 
between countries.

paragraphs.text: The pandemic has had a negative social and economic effect on everyone, but the consequences for lower-income countries have been particularly severe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The pandemic has had a negative social and economic effect on everyone, but 
the consequences for lower-income countries have been particularly severe.

paragraphs.text: Even before the health crisis, these countries had significant economic vulnerabilities, starting with their debt levels.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Even before the health crisis, these countries had significant economic 
vulnerabilities, starting with their debt levels.

paragraphs.text: Many of their citizens lived below or just above the poverty line.
paragraphs.raw_text: Many of their citizens lived below or just above the poverty line.

paragraphs.raw_text:
Advanced economies have been able to use monetary and fiscal policies more

paragraphs.raw_text:
They spent 28 per cent of their 2020 gross domestic product to stimulate 
growth — compared with just 7 per cent and 2 per cent in emerging and 
low-income economies.

paragraphs.raw_text:
Economic divergence risks erasing years of progress in the fight against 
poverty, making it even more difficult to achieve sustainable development goals.

paragraphs.text: Concerns about food systems have become even more urgent.
paragraphs.raw_text: Concerns about food systems have become even more urgent.

paragraphs.raw_text:
Extreme weather conditions and supply chain disruptions have contributed to

paragraphs.raw_text: In August the food price index rose by 32 per cent compared to a year earlier.

paragraphs.raw_text:
According to the FAO, last year more than 2,3 billion people did not have

paragraphs.raw_text:
Under the Italian Presidency, the G20 has adopted a package of economic

paragraphs.text: We support the need for a consensual reform of the Security Council, to strengthen regional representation and ensure a fairer geographical distribution of seats through an increase in the number of elected members.

paragraphs.text: Our goal is to make the Council more representative, democratic, efficient, transparent and accountable.
